text:
Jordan: heads-up — billing-bot flagged a big jump in untagged GPU spend in eu-west-1 overnight (~$12k last 24h). anyone else seeing this?
billing-bot: Automated alert: 2026-03-17 04:12 UTC — Unlabeled resources > $10k in 24h (region: europe-west1). Report ID: ab12-untag-2026.
Priya (finance): yikes. can you paste the query you ran? finance needs to map to chargeback buckets.
Jordan: running the BQ export now, but quick summary: most of the charge is from a dedicated pool created Tuesday that doesn't have cost_center tags.
Noah (platform): that would be the new dedicated pool we created for the europe beta customers — project name = redwood-dedicated-eu-pt1. I remember a terraform module change.
Eli (sre): do we have an audit event? maybe someone deployed without the tagging hook.
Jordan: here's the query I used (BigQuery billing export):
```sql
SELECT service.description, sku.description, project.id, labels.key, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice.month = '2026-03' AND billing_account_id = '012345-6789AB-CDEF' AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(project.id, 'dedicated-eu')
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Zoe (eng): I pushed a patch to the dedicated pool terraform last week that changed `google_compute_instance` metadata -> `resource_labels`. maybe the label mappers didn't pick it up.
Noah (platform): confirmed — the label mapper service checks `labels` not `resource_labels`. terraform diff slipped by because the pre-apply hook ran in a fork branch and the check didn't run.
Priya (finance): immediate ask: can we backfill labels so charges are attributed before month end? finance needs daily cost by product.
Eli (sre): we can run a one-off tag backfill script against the project if IAM allows. low risk.
Jordan: I have a quick script to patch labels via gcloud. test-run on a single instance went fine. plan: run for project scope and then re-run the BQ query to confirm.
Jordan: patch (example):
```bash
# add cost_center label to all instances in a project
for inst in $(gcloud compute instances list --project=redwood-dedicated-eu-pt1 --format='value(name)'); do
  gcloud compute instances add-labels $inst --labels=cost_center=dedicated-eu --project=redwood-dedicated-eu-pt1 --zone=eu-west1-b
done
```
Priya (finance): good — once you backfill, finance can re-run allocations and update chargebacks. please confirm post-backfill numbers.
Noah (platform): long-term fix: restore the terraform module to write `labels` (top-level) and add gate to CI to fail on missing cost_center tag for any dedicated pool resources. I'll open a PR.
Zoe (eng): noted — I accidentally introduced `resource_labels` while testing a provider upgrade. reopening the change now.
Eli (sre): also add a nightly audit that compares billing export project labels -> resource labels and alerts on mismatches. this will catch provider-driven attribute moves.
billing-bot: Created ticket INC-2026-334 in incidents for follow-up: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-334
Priya (finance): can we also checkpoint reserved capacity mapping? if this pool was supposed to be covered by a reserved commitment, misattribution will skew utilization numbers.
Jordan: checking committed usage tables... initial look shows committed sku attached to org-level contract, but project-level mapping is empty for that pool (likely because label missing).
Noah (platform): if cost_center is `dedicated-eu`, we'll map it to the reserved contract `RC-EU-2026`. I'll add a mapping rule so the chargeback job will include it retroactively for March.
Zoe (eng): rolling the terraform change now, will run the internal preflight and then push the backfill. ETA 30m.
Eli (sre): after backfill, let's run reconciliation:
1) rerun BQ query for untagged resources
2) compare daily cost delta pre/post backfill
3) update chargeback sheet and notify teams
Jordan: will post results here. if anything blocks, ping @noah or @eli.
Priya (finance): thanks all. finance wants an informal postmortem in the weekly ops sync: root cause, remediation, and an action item to prevent recurrence.
Jordan: agreed — I'll attach the query results and the backfill log to the INC ticket.
Zoe (eng): backfill started, hitting some instances with old images -> will retry with zone-scoped exponential backoff.
billing-bot: Backfill job status: running (32/120 instances patched). ETA ~12m.
Jordan: preliminary numbers after ~50% complete: untagged GPU spend for redwood-dedicated-eu-pt1 dropped by ~$6.3k in the window; full reconciliation pending.
Priya (finance): ok that's promising. once full, finance will recalc chargebacks and let product teams know.
Noah (platform): opened PR #482 to revert the provider change and added CI gate. reviewers: @eli @zoe.
Eli (sre): thanks — also adding an automated audit (alert threshold $1k/day untagged) to reduce noise but catch real spikes.
Jordan: final note for the ticket: root cause = terraform provider upgrade changed label attribute (`labels` -> `resource_labels`), CI gate missing for labeling, retro tag backfill performed. action items: backfill, terraform rollback PR, CI gate, nightly audit, finance reconciliation.
Priya (finance): perfect — keep me posted.
Zoe (eng): done — backfill completed. full reconciliation scheduled.
Jordan: closing thread after I upload logs to INC-2026-334. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
